cohort_rule: Original five items selected by original-train coverage at2017-01-31 and then fixed; every rolling CV target is after this selection cutoff
common_keys: Fixed intersection of finite B0/B1/priorPoisson predictions per original period; candidates cannot remove inconvenient dates and keep all these keys using flagged B1 fallback
deployment: No operational API integration, SQLite writes, physical unit conversion, economic/savings claims or public raw data.
features: prior7 mean minus previous7 mean min3 each
history_mode: Explicit rolling-one-day-ahead; only previous day-complete observations may update lags; no intra-day or fixed-horizon claims
output: Named ML residual correction plus B1, clipped to nonnegative count. Nonfinite/failed model falls back to unchanged B1, with explicit flags; never operational quantities
report: All fixed candidates CV/validation/peritem/fallback results, selection reasons, predictions and coverage; chosen-candidate test exploratory label; missing-SKU sensitivity and first/second temporal test halves; source/protocol/version hashes; reproducible JSON without timestamps

selection.metrics_note: MAE and WAPE on identical labels rank identically; WAPE is descriptive, not a second independent win.
selection.no_eligible_candidate: retain B1; no claimed ML win
selection.primary_metric: original validation pooled MAE, observed-store-zero, identical reference keys

sensitivity_zero_policy: missing; validation guard only, no reranking based on test sensitivity
target: transaction item-line count per selected item per observed store date; not pieces/demand
test_execution: Choose using full validation model fitted on original train and rolling CV after selection cutoff, plus missing-validation guard. Final chosen model and references remain fitted on original train; original previously-seen test is scored once after selection. No unselected test scores.
test_status: Previously inspected original test; any new score is exploratory, not fresh independent evidence
training: Final validation model fits original train only. Internal rolling CV may fit earlier validation prefixes, strictly before each fold target. Residual target actual minus past-only B1; at least14 fit rows/item; no test fitting.
transform: Each fold train-only median imputer+missing indicators, scaler and onehot; missing labels remain absent or explicitly inferred zeros according to frozen policy
